text:
anya: Heads-up — prepping 3.2.1-kernel + quant-lite bundle for midnight change window (00:30 UTC). Need to pin EU/APAC nodes to legacy engine during rollout. Also we should split release notes: short ops section + user-facing callout.
kevin: What triggered the pin? Thermal regression in canary?
maria: Canary had ~0.8% p99 token latency increase, failure rate stable. Heatmap shows GPU-0 local throttling. See snippet:
```
canary_metrics:
  p99_latency: 142ms -> 153ms
  error_rate: 0.1% -> 0.11%
  gpu_temp_peak: 86C
```
kevin: ok. Any binary ABI change? need to update engine-shim?
anya: No ABI change. It's a kernel memory layout tweak that interacts with quant packing. We observed occasional kv cache spill. Rolling quant build with a funnel patch — safe path is pin.
deploybot: preflight: canary-run passed for x86/amd64, failed on aarch64: 1 test flake (kv-evict). Full logs: https://internal/builds/175987/canary
ops-bot: FYI automated fallback triggers at >0.5% p99 regress for 10m
maria: I think pin EU/Asia, let US run soft-canary (5% traffic) and monitor. Also put throttling ramp: 5 -> 20 -> 50 over 30m.
kevin: Agree. Who owns release notes?
anya: I'll draft ops blurb. @maria please add user-facing note about embeddings differences.
maria: On it. Will add a sentence about slight perf variance and rollback plan.
kevin: Command to pin (for ops runbook):
```
./deploybot pin --region eu,ap --engine legacy-3.2.0 --ttl 6h --reason "kernel+quant canary thermal"
```
deploybot: ack: scheduled pin job id=pin-175987-01, ETA 00:15 UTC
anya: Action items:
- anya: submit release note ops blurb + link in release thread
- maria: user-facing blurb + examples, monitor canary dashboards
- kevin: run preflight aarch64 re-run at 23:45 UTC
- deploybot: execute pin and report
kevin: I'll also prepare rollback playbook: revert to qbundle v3.1 and runtime 3.2.0, run warm-restart.
maria: gating metrics to watch: p99, error_rate, kv_evictions, gpu_temp. Set alert slack->eng-runtime if p99 > +1.0% for 15m.
anya: Great. If all green after 45m ramp, we'll unpin US and proceed with regional swap. :thumbsup:
deploybot: pin-complete: pin-175987-01 applied to eu,ap at 00:14:22 UTC
maria: aarch64 re-run started 23:50 UTC
kevin: aarch64 re-run passed at 00:06 UTC, no kv-evict
anya: Thanks team — I'll post a short summary in #release-war-room and attach notes.
